steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The UK produces approximately 9.5 million tonnes of food waste per year; about 70% of this was intended for human consumption and could have been eaten.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Food waste occurs at every stage: production (crops left in fields), processing (trimming, quality rejection), retail (overstocking, past display dates), and consumer (over-buying, cooking too much, not using leftovers).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Households produce the most food waste (around 70% of the UK total), mainly from buying too much, not using food before it spoils, and cooking larger portions than needed.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: When food waste goes to landfill, it decomposes anaerobically, producing methane — a greenhouse gas 25 times more potent than carbon dioxide.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: Approximately how much food waste does the UK produce per year? | Q: Which sector produces the most food waste in the UK? | Q: Why is sending food waste to landfill particularly harmful to the environment?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Around 9.5 million tonnes per year, of which about 70% was intended for human consumption and could have been eaten. | Households — they produce around 70% of UK food waste, mainly from over-buying, not using food before it spoils, and cooking too much. | In landfill, food decomposes anaerobically (without oxygen), producing methane — a greenhouse gas 25 times more potent than CO2 that contributes significantly to climate change.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Use statistics to support your answers: 9.5 million tonnes of UK food waste, 70% from households, methane is 25x more potent than CO2. When discussing food waste, structure your answer by stage of the supply chain: production, processing, retail, consumer. For sustainability questions, always link waste reduction to environmental AND economic benefits. Know the difference between anaerobic digestion (produces energy and fertiliser) and composting (produces soil conditioner).
